description: This PHP source file defines a model class 'NodeTeam' that represents team members associated with nodes in the application. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, saving, and validating node team data, along with handling related images.

classes.name: NodeTeam
classes.description: Model class representing a node team member, providing methods to get, list, save, and validate team member data within the application's data layer.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the database fields that need language-specific translation, specifically 'role'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific node team member by ID, with optional language join.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of node team members, optionally filtered by node ID, with pagination.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the Image object associated with the team member.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current node team member object to the database after validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the node team member object before saving, ensuring required fields are present.
